definitions.t_grasp: s from the commit (the arm starts toward the item) to the jaws closed
definitions.t_return: s from the jaws closed to the arm ready for the next item (placed and back, or retreated after a miss)
definitions.y: belt y (m) of the item when the jaws closed; window_m: span of 4 cm bins (n ≥ 3) with success ≥ 50 % of the peak bin
definitions.outcomes: per attempt; success, miss, knock_off, drop_belt, drop_off, drop_other_bin, wrong_bin
definitions.passes: items the policy let pass without an attempt, by reason
definitions.free: the arm became free at a uniform belt y in [-0.15, 0.155] m; items alone on the belt, lateral offset ±0.015 m
